spell.evocation_expansion.disarm.guide: Fire a short-ranged gust that knocks the item from a creature's main hand.
spell.evocation_expansion.float.guide: Suspend yourself in the air for three seconds while retaining horizontal movement.
spell.evocation_expansion.uppercut.guide: Launch creatures directly ahead into the air and propel yourself upward, even while airborne.
spell.evocation_expansion.swing.guide: Fire a chain that anchors to terrain or creatures. Hold the cast to swing and release it to let go.
spell.evocation_expansion.hook_shot.guid: Pull yourself toward terrain or drag a struck creature toward you with an evoked chain.
spell.evocation_expansion.magic_fireball: Launch a deflectable fireball that curves smoothly toward the nearest enemy.
spell.evocation_expansion.successive_fla: Wind up, then carve through enemies with five alternating flame strikes that carry you forward.
spell.evocation_expansion.arrow_storm.gu: Conjure a scattered formation of magic arrows behind you that surges forward in rapid waves.
spell.evocation_expansion.heavy_shadow_s: Charge a heavier shadow slash that crashes forward with greater force and a wider arc.
death.attack.evocation_expansion.heavy_s: %1$s was cleaved apart by %2$s's heavy shadow slash.
